slides.heading: Auto-Replies That Still **Book** Viewings
slides.body: Off on Sunday? Your reply doesn't have to be.

slides.heading: Sound **Like You**
slides.body: Use your name and a warm hello. Not 'Your message has been received.'

slides.heading: Say When **You're Back**
slides.body: 'Monday 9am' beats 'we'll get back to you soon.'

slides.heading: Offer **Two Slots**
slides.body: Let them pick a viewing time now, while they're still keen.

slides.heading: The **Script**
bullets: Hi, Kofi here. Thanks for messaging!

slides.heading: Confirm On **Monday**
slides.body: Reply first thing. Confirm the slot and send the location pin.
